scenarios.description: The control calls without playback: the answers before a player exists, the MIDI tools, the rejected calls and the stopped transport with an open stream.
Play from a position; pause, seek while paused and resume; seek while playing; stop.
A play range that stops by itself, with a limiter on the master (graph latency).
A loop that is not aligned to beats, with the metronome on, over more than two passes.
A duplex recording from beat 3 with a one-bar count-in in 3/4 (the null device captures silence), with an instrument playing along.
